variants.maintainer_notes: New variant: the RAM variant's command with --write-flash, which writes the GW1N's internal flash. Not tried on hardware. Device selection (2026-11-04): --busdev-num ${BUS}:${DEV} added so openFPGALoader opens the device the engine chose, not the first one with these USB IDs. Low risk, so tested is unchanged: openFPGALoader's FTDI drivers (MPSSE, bitbang, CH552) open the device by bus and address when given (src/ftdipp_mpsse.cpp, ftdi_usb_open_bus_addr); not tried on hardware.
